records.original_evidence: Bone contusion of right femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau, R/O subchondral fracture of lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau
records.source_quote:
Abnormal signal intensity is noted in femoral medial/ lateral condyle and tibial lateral condyle, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.
* Irregular contour of inferior-lateral portion of right femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau, R/O subchondral fracture.
* Linear signal intensity in anterior horn of lateral meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of contusion.
> Fabella is noted in the lateral head of gastrocneums muscle.
> Increased hyperintensity signal over meniscocapsular junction region of posterior horn of medial meniscus, R/O meniscocapsular separation at the interface of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
> Linear signal intensity in anterior horn of lateral meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of  grade 2 intrasubstance signal, maybe due to degeneration or meniscal vascularity 
> Mild interstitial increased singal of iliotibial band and distal LCL-biceps femoris tendon on F/S T2WI, in favor of tendinosis.
> Linear hyperintensity signal of MCL on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 MCL injury and MCL bursitis.
> Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus, R/O Anserine bursitis

Impression:
1. Bone contusion of right femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau, R/O subchondral fracture of lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau (Srs/Img: [ID].
